description: SKELETON ONLY: every element is listed with an "unmatched" target so the mapping work is visible. No LOINC/SNOMED target has been guessed. Fill in `target` after terminology review.

element.display: Sequence unknown, or systemic therapy is the main treatment modality (nodal lymphoma, haematologic malignancy, or distant metastasis)
The first course had only regional drug therapy (TACE, intraperitoneal, intrapleural, intrathecal, intravesical, intraocular or intratumoral), with no systemic drug therapy
No locoregional therapy: the first course had systemic drug therapy only (regional drug therapy such as TACE may still have been given)
Unknown whether the case had locoregional and/or systemic therapy
No systemic drug therapy in the first course (chemotherapy, hormone/steroid, immunotherapy or targeted therapy), whether or not locoregional therapy was given
Induction / neoadjuvant systemic therapy (before locoregional therapy, or before radiation when radiation is the main locoregional therapy)
Concurrent / concomitant systemic and radiation therapy (CSRT), or perioperative systemic therapy given around surgery

Induction / neoadjuvant systemic therapy (before locoregional therapy, or before radiation when radiation is the main locoregional therapy) + Concurrent / concomitant systemic and radiation therapy (CSRT), or perioperative systemic therapy given around surgery
Induction / neoadjuvant systemic therapy (before locoregional therapy, or before radiation when radiation is the main locoregional therapy) + Adjuvant systemic therapy (after locoregional therapy)
Concurrent / concomitant systemic and radiation therapy (CSRT), or perioperative systemic therapy given around surgery + Adjuvant systemic therapy (after locoregional therapy)

Induction / neoadjuvant systemic therapy (before locoregional therapy, or before radiation when radiation is the main locoregional therapy) + Concurrent / concomitant systemic and radiation therapy (CSRT), or perioperative systemic therapy given around surgery + Adjuvant systemic therapy (after locoregional therapy)
